facts.text: The Bearkat Promise covers at least $5,685 in mandatory tuition and fees each semester for 15 credit hours using grant funds, supporting Texas students with family income up to $100,000.

sources.title: Bearkat Promise
sources.quote: The Bearkat Promise is SHSU's commitment to making college more affordable for Texas students. The Bearkat Promise covers at least $5,685 in mandatory¹ tuition and fees each semester (15 credit hours) with only grant funds, not loans.

sources.title: Bearkat Promise
sources.quote: The Bearkat Promise program supports students with family income² up to $100,000!
